verdict.rationale: Omnara's core interaction model is conversational: users send corrections, queue tasks, and attach content to an ongoing conversation with an agent, and can operate agents via dashboard or Slack in natural language (omnara-docs-7, omnara-docs-9, omnara-gh-3). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language parsing/intent handling and independent hands-on validation that NL commands are reliably interpreted (community threads focus on pricing/UI, not NL command quality).
